origin.description: CSS rules that map each class to an 8-bit color. rgb.mix is applied with the local col2rgb and rgb conversions.
origin.details: CSS rules that map each class to an 8-bit color. rgb.mix is applied with the local col2rgb and rgb conversions.
origin.value: A character vector, or the previous hooks for set_knit_hooks.
origin.example:
names16 <- do.call(paste, c(expand.grid(c("fg", "bg"), 0:7), sep = "-"))
mix <- matrix(c(.6, .2, .2, .2, .6, .2, .2, .2, .6), 3)
writeLines(make_styles(names16, mix))

translation.description: CSS rules that map each class to an 8-bit color. rgb.mix is applied with the local col2rgb and rgb conversions.
translation.details: CSS rules that map each class to an 8-bit color. rgb.mix is applied with the local col2rgb and rgb conversions. A string is one element. None is a missing string. class is written class_.
translation.value: A list of strings, or a dict of the previous hooks for set_knit_hooks.
translation.example:
from fansi.make_styles import make_styles
names16 = [f"{side}-{index}" for index in range(8) for side in ("fg", "bg")]
mix = [[0.6, 0.2, 0.2], [0.2, 0.6, 0.2], [0.2, 0.2, 0.6]]
for line in make_styles(names16, mix):
    print(line)
